intro: Searn Firewarder is a Darkspear troll shaman trainer stationed inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. He assists developing shamans across the Horde, directing them toward the trials needed to commune with the elemental spirits of fire, water, and air.

p: Standing within the fortified walls of Grommash Hold alongside the Horde's high command, Searn Firewarder serves as an elemental guide for aspiring shamans. While many Darkspear trolls commune with the spirits through witch doctors and voodoo rituals, Searn represents the bond troll shamans forge directly with the living elements of Kalimdor. He acts as an intermediary, directing initiates toward the far-flung mentors and rites required to earn the Call of Fire, Call of Water, and Call of Air.
